facts.text: Cameron House is set on the shores of Loch Lomond, within Loch Lomond & The Trossachs National Park.
facts.excerpt: Set on the shores of Loch Lomond, within Loch Lomond & The Trossachs National Park, Cameron House is a five star Scottish resort

facts.text: The Auld House is a baronial mansion adorned with towers and turrets, home to individually styled suites and rooms each named after one of Loch Lomond's islands.
facts.excerpt: Eye-catching towers and turrets adorn our baronial mansion, home to individually styled suites and rooms, each named after one of Loch Lomond’s islands.

facts.text: Auld House suites differ from the other rooms by their increased space and additional amenities like terraces or balconies.
facts.excerpt: The main difference between Auld House suites and the others is their increased space, size and additional amenities like terraces or balconies.

facts.text: Bedrooms come in a contemporary or classic atmosphere with estate or loch views.
facts.excerpt: Choose from a contemporary or classic atmosphere and revel in beautiful estate or loch views.

facts.text: Lodges, cottages and Mansion House Apartments across the grounds provide self-catering stays for up to eight guests.
facts.excerpt: discover a collection of spacious lodges, cottages, and Mansion House Apartments that provide the perfect countryside escape for up to eight guests.

facts.text: The Carrick is the resort's 18-hole championship course, with elevation changes that create views, particularly from the 10th and 14th holes.
facts.excerpt: The Carrick is our 18-hole championship course, host to prestigious events and with fascinating elevation changes that create exceptional views, particularly from the 10th and 14th holes.

facts.text: The 9-hole Wee Demon course is an option for beginners or those looking to fine tune their swing.
facts.excerpt: It’s the ideal option for beginners or those looking to fine tune their swing.

facts.text: Cameron Spa has an indoor pool and a rooftop infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Cameron Spa also has an indoor pool and a rooftop infinity pool.

facts.text: Hotel residents get complimentary access to the Health Club, with its pool, family splash zone and bubble pool in the main hotel building.
facts.excerpt: Hotel residents can enjoy complimentary access to the Health Club throughout their stay.

facts.text: The resort's own motor cruiser, the Celtic Warrior, takes cruises on the loch that take in islands including Inchmurrin and hidden coves only visible by boat.
facts.excerpt: We offer our very own Celtic Warrior. Each cruise on the loch takes in some of the loch’s islands, including Inchmurrin, and hidden coves only visible by boat.

facts.text: Experiences include speedboat and water experiences, jet skiing, falconry, archery, 4x4 adventures and the Cameron Cinema.
facts.excerpt: **Speedboat & Water Experiences**

facts.text: Falconry with the resort's expert is offered.
facts.excerpt: **Falconry with Our Expert**

facts.text: Family activities include bike hire, paddle boarding, horse riding, a swimming pool and a cinema.
facts.excerpt: We offer a range of activities to keep your little ones occupied including bike hire, paddle boarding, horse riding, a swimming pool, a cinema and so much more.

facts.text: Restaurants include Cameron Grill and La Vista, which serves seafood.
facts.excerpt: From intimate and inviting fare at Cameron Grill to delicious seafood at La Vista and everything in between

facts.text: The resort's dining includes LOMA by Graeme Cheevers.
facts.excerpt: ### LOMA by Graeme Cheevers

facts.text: Cameron House is 30 minutes from the city centre of Glasgow.
facts.excerpt: we’re only 30 minutes away from the city centre of Glasgow

facts.text: Cameron Spa access is available for an additional cost and is located 3 miles from the main hotel building.
facts.excerpt: Cameron Spa access is available for an additional cost. It is located 3 miles from the main hotel building

facts.text: The hotel is dog friendly, with a maximum of two dogs for an additional charge.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Cameron House Hotel is dog friendly. You can bring a maximum of two dogs to stay, for an additional charge.

facts.text: Dogs are not permitted in apartments, cottages or lodges, except support animals.
facts.excerpt: Unfortunately dogs are not permitted in apartments, cottages or lodges except for dogs which are a support animal

facts.text: The self-catering lodges, cottages and apartments are not specifically adapted for accessibility.
facts.excerpt: Our self-catering lodges, cottages and apartments are not specifically adapted for accessibility.
